book.name: 2 Thessalonica
book.title: Paul Secon Letta Ta Dem Een Thessalonica

content: De Wickity One wa da Fight Ginst God
Now den, we wahn fa taak ta oona bout wen we Lawd Jedus Christ gwine come back an geda we all togeda fa be wid um. We Christian bredren, we da beg oona,

mus dohn leh nobody bumfumble oona no way, needa leh um git oona opsot all ob a sudden cause dey da tell oona say de day ob de Lawd done come. Wen somebody da tell oona say e done see de Lawd come, or wen somebody say e done yeh say e done come, or dat e yeh say we done write bout dat een a letta, oona mus dohn bleebe um.

Mus dohn leh nobody fool oona nohow. Cause dat day ob de Lawd ain gwine come til de time wen heapa people gwine ton ginst God. An dat day ain gwine come needa til de man wa da fight ginst God een ebry way gwine appeah. God done mek plan fa sen dat wickity man ta e ruint faeba een hell.

Dat man wa da fight ginst God, e gwine fight ginst all de sperit an ting dem wa people call dey god an dey woshup um. E gwine pit esef op high, da say e got mo powa den all ob dem ting dey. An e eben gwine seddown een God House an tell ebrybody dat e God.
Oona memba, ainty? Wen A stillyet been dey wid oona, A beena tell oona bout all dat.
An oona know wa da keep um fom come yet, so wen de right time come, dat man gwine appeah.

Bot dat same powa wa da wok een dat man, e da wok so dat plenty people da do dem ting wa God say we ain oughta do. An wa God done show dat oda people ain know, dat wa mek we able fa ondastan dis. Bot all dat wa gwine happen ain gwine happen til God tek way de one wa da keep um fom come.
Dat de time wen de one wa da fight God gwine appeah. Bot de Lawd Jedus gwine kill dat one wid de bret wa come outta e mout. De glory ob de Lawd Jedus wen e come back, dat gwine stroy dat one.

Satan gwine mek dat one wa da fight God come, an e gwine wok een um fa gim all de powa e need. Dat one gwine mek people fool, da bumfumble um wid de plenty lyin miracle an wondaful sign an wok e gwine do.
E gwine do all kind ob ebil ting wa gwine ceebe dem wa gwine be loss. Dem people, dey gwine be loss cause dey ain wahn fa lob de trute so dat dey kin git sabe.
Cause ob dat, God gwine sen a powa wa ceebe people an wa ain gwine leh um tink scraight, so dat dey gwine bleebe de ting wa ain true.
An dat wa gwine mek God condemn all ob dem wa ain bleebe de trute, bot beena lob fa do wickity ting.

We Christian bredren, oona wa de Lawd lob, we mus tell God tankya fa oona all de time. Cause fom de fus, God done pick oona fa sabe oona by de powa ob de Holy Sperit fa mek oona come fa be God own holy people, an fa sabe oona by oona fait een de trute.
God call oona fa be e own people shru e Good Nyews wa we tell oona. Dat so oona gwine git oona paat een dat same glory ob we Lawd Jedus Christ.
So den, we Christian bredren, oona mus stan scrong een de Lawd. All de time oona haat mus hole on ta all de trute wa we been laan oona, wen we been dey da taak ta oona an wen we write letta ta oona.
We pray dat we Lawd Jedus Christ an God we Fada, wa lob we an een e mussy gii we courage faeba an mek we all de time able fa look fowaad ta good ting,
e gwine courage oona haat an mek oona scrong fa do an say all wa good fa true.
